baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ qualified by لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْءَاخِرَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A desirable pattern is made available for enactment, and hope directed toward God and the later horizon supplies the motive for following it.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies an exemplar followed in another's state, making enacted imitation the model's core operation.
The branch supplies desirability opposed to ugliness and marks the pattern as worth adopting.
The branch supplies the heart's expectant reach toward what is hoped for and thus the motive that energizes imitation.
The branch supplies what comes after the first and extends the evaluative horizon beyond the present relation.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely says that certain people are a good example.
changed_reading.after: The ayah offers a performable pattern whose goodness becomes compelling when action is measured against God and the later horizon rather than immediate social ease.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lexical field of أُسْوَةٌ, its qualification as حَسَنَةٌ, and the closing contrast between human turning and divine self-sufficiency.
baseline_models.mechanism: The exemplar can function as treatment for a damaged relation: it repairs by a practiced good, while refusal to undergo that repair harms the refuser rather than making God needy.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes treatment of a wound and turns exemplarity into a therapeutic operation on relational injury.
The branch contributes repair and solidarity, defining the treatment as socially enacted rather than privately admired.
The branch contributes beneficent and well-made action as the substance through which repair occurs.
The branch contributes withdrawal and refusal, identifying the failure mode as turning away from the reparative pattern.
The branch contributes freedom from need and locates the benefit of repair on the human side rather than in a divine deficit.

changed_reading.before: Uswa names only a person or precedent to copy.
changed_reading.after: Uswa also names a good reparative practice: a way to treat a social wound whose rejection deprives the human agent, not God.

baseline_models.mechanism: Hope places the reader at the edge of a deferred, severe event; the exemplar is training for conduct at that threshold, where present attachments are viewed from their far side.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes an edge or side and spatializes hope as taking one's stance at a threshold.
The branch contributes deferral to a later time and makes the threshold temporally delayed rather than absent.
The branch contributes a day as a descending severe event, giving the deferred horizon existential weight.
The branch contributes the rear or far end and lets the present be judged from its eventual backside.

changed_reading.before: Hope for the last day is a general belief condition appended to the example.
changed_reading.after: Hope is a threshold posture: the exemplar rehearses how to act now while standing imaginatively at the far edge of the event that will expose present choices.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A person may withdraw from the pattern, but withdrawal creates no bargaining power over God: God both lacks need and remains praiseworthy, so the consequence loops back onto the withdrawing agent.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes active withdrawal and makes refusal a relational movement away from the offered pattern.
The branch contributes lack of need and blocks the inference that human refusal diminishes God.
The branch contributes sufficiency that can stand in for another, making divine sufficiency the ground on which the human choice is exposed.
The branch contributes praise opposed to blame and prevents refusal from becoming a successful indictment of the source of the pattern.

changed_reading.before: The close is only a threat against whoever turns away.
changed_reading.after: The close diagnoses an asymmetry: refusal is real agency but cannot make God dependent, diminished, or blameworthy, so its loss remains with the refuser.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context turns the focus exemplar into boundary surgery: chosen alliance, projected affection, and concealed intimacy can carry loyalty across a line already marked by expulsion and hostility, so the exemplar treats where attachment is placed rather than extinguishing affection itself.

activation_trace.role: Wound treatment anchors the focus reading as an intervention in an injured relational field.
Taking or acquiring supplies the deliberate formation of an alliance and identifies the boundary-crossing act as chosen.
Exceeding a limit and doing wrong supplies the breached boundary that makes relational treatment necessary.
Casting something outward supplies affection as a directed transfer rather than an inert feeling.
Love and affection supply the relational material being redirected rather than simply suppressed.
Concealment in the interior supplies the hidden channel through which misplaced attachment can evade public boundaries.

structural_cues: 60:1 pairs a prohibition on taking enemies as allies with twice-mentioned affection and a hidden-versus-declared contrast.
60:2 gives the hostile relation bodily and verbal outputs through extended hands and tongues.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chosen alliance, cast affection, concealed interiority, and hostile action; I infer that attachment crosses and reopens a damaged boundary, while the live alternative is a narrower reading in which the exemplar only prohibits an alliance category.

changed_reading.before: The good exemplar is a generic moral precedent.
changed_reading.after: The good exemplar is a technique for relocating loyalty after injury: it treats the channels by which intimacy can silently override a necessary boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later day is shown separating agents from kinship utility; therefore hope for that day makes the exemplar a discipline for surviving the moment when family nearness cannot substitute for accountable action.

activation_trace.role: The severe-event day anchors the focus horizon as an exposing occurrence rather than a vague future.
What comes after the first supplies the horizon from which present family attachments are reevaluated.
Womb-based kinship supplies the strongest natural bond whose utility is explicitly denied at the decisive horizon.
Offspring from one's line extends the kinship bond across generations and shows the breadth of what cannot substitute for action.
Separating one thing until its boundary appears supplies the decisive disclosure of personal accountability.
Parting and separation give spatial form to the judgment that kinship cannot erase individual consequence.

structural_cues: 60:3 denies benefit from womb-relations and children, then places separation on the resurrection day.
The focus repeats both day-language and an audience defined by hope for the later day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kinship, denied benefit, and eschatological separation; I infer that the exemplar trains an agent to bear present kinship pressure in advance of that separation, while the alternative is that 60:3 merely supplies a deterrent without shaping exemplarity.

changed_reading.before: Hope for the last day is a general pious qualification.
changed_reading.after: Hope for the last day is the capacity to let accountable action outrank even womb and offspring when those bonds press against the exemplar.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier occurrence supplies a detailed precedent and then carves out an explicit exception inside it. The focus repetition therefore ratifies a bounded composite: public dissociation from worship and hostile allegiance, coupled with reliance, return, and final orientation, but not unqualified copying of every utterance.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch anchors the model in exemplarity and receives its selectable content from the earlier repeated formula.
The repeated exemplar branch establishes a direct lexical bridge from the detailed precedent to the focus summary.
Distance and disavowal supply the precedent's boundary-making action.
Open declaration of hostility supplies publicity and prevents the boundary from remaining a concealed attitude.
Covering sin and protecting its bearer supplies the exceptional paternal promise that the syntax marks off from the model.
Possession and disposal supply the speaker's disclaimer that he controls nothing for his father against God.
Reliance supplies the positive orientation that accompanies dissociation and keeps the model from being pure negation.
Repeated return supplies a reversible Godward motion after the social declaration.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the final destination that organizes the whole precedent.

structural_cues: 60:4 uses the same أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ formula as the focus and then explicitly introduces an exception.
The focus says فِيهِمْ in the plural, pointing back to a collective pattern rather than isolating one dramatic declaration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, plural reference, a detailed sequence, and an explicit exception; I infer that the second formula performs selective ratification, while the live alternative is that it only emphatically repeats a single undifferentiated example.

changed_reading.before: The focus commands wholesale imitation of a famous act of dissociation.
changed_reading.after: The focus ratifies an exception-aware composite pattern: visible boundary, disclaimed control, reliance, return, and outcome-orientation must be imitated together and selectively.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, the exemplars pray not to become an ordeal and ask forgiveness. Their modeled goodness therefore includes exposure to failure and dependence; only the God named self-sufficient in the focus stands outside that need.

activation_trace.role: Trial and affliction supply the feared condition in which the community itself could become damaging evidence for others.
Covering fault and protecting its bearer supply the exemplars' admitted need for repair.
Freedom from need establishes a contrast between dependent exemplars and the independent God toward whom they turn.
Praise opposed to blame keeps admitted human vulnerability from transferring deficiency to God.

structural_cues: 60:5 is a first-person plural prayer by the very group presented as exemplary in 60:4 and summarized again in 60:6.
The focus closes by reserving self-sufficiency for God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exemplary speakers who fear becoming a trial and seek forgiveness, followed by divine self-sufficiency; I infer a contrast between imitable dependence and unique independence, while the alternative treats the prayer as separate from the exemplar's content.

changed_reading.before: A good exemplar is a self-assured moral hero whose strength is copied.
changed_reading.after: A good exemplar also models vulnerable dependence: fear of becoming harmful and a request for forgiveness belong inside the pattern, while self-sufficiency belongs to God alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verse immediately after the focus presents hostility as a relation God can transform into affection, then names forgiveness and mercy. The exemplar's boundary is therefore real but permeable to changed conditions; it is not a mandate to preserve hostility as an identity.

activation_trace.role: Turning away anchors the focus's negative response but leaves open what future relation may follow.
Expectant hope anchors the reader in openness to a good not yet present.
Making a thing become a state supplies the transformation arrow from current hostility to another relation.
Enemy and hostility supply the starting social state rather than an immutable personal essence.
Love and affection supply the genuinely different relation into which hostility may be remade.
Protection from a fault's effect supplies a mechanism by which past hostility need not dictate the future.
Merciful tenderness supplies the affective environment in which transformed relation becomes possible.

structural_cues: 60:7 follows the focus without an intervening topic break and explicitly moves from those you treated as enemies to possible affection.
The verse ends with power, forgiveness, and mercy rather than with permanent enmity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a state-making verb between hostility and affection plus forgiveness and mercy; I infer that changed conduct can reopen relation, while the live alternative is that the verse promises divine possibility without prescribing human proximity before change occurs.

changed_reading.before: The exemplar establishes a permanent hostile separation.
changed_reading.after: The exemplar establishes a truthful present boundary that remains open to God-enabled reconciliation when the relation itself changes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired rulings distinguish noncombatants from those who fight, expel, and support expulsion. Relation is calibrated by conduct: expansive good and justice remain available across difference, while protective non-alliance answers active aggression and rights-denial.

activation_trace.role: Exemplarity anchors the paired rulings as specifications of how the focus pattern is enacted.
Mutual fighting supplies the expressly absent conduct that keeps relation open.
Passage to the outside supplies expulsion as the second expressly absent injury.
Connection and beneficence opposed to severing supply a positive relation toward those not committing the injuries.
Justice and equity supply the stable measure governing the open relation.
Mutual combat now supplies an actually present aggression that changes the relational ruling.
Repeated outward expulsion supplies direct and assisted displacement as conduct requiring a boundary.
Strengthening another by one's back supplies material support for expulsion, widening responsibility beyond direct perpetrators.
Love, support, and alliance supply the prohibited relation specifically toward active aggressors and their supporters.
Withholding and confining a right supplies the consequence of misplacing alliance where justice requires restraint.

structural_cues: 60:8 and 60:9 have matched syntax but opposite rulings keyed to fighting, expulsion, and assistance in expulsion.
The positive side contains both beneficence and justice, not mere toleration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a controlled contrast in conduct and ruling; I infer that conduct, not group identity alone, is the operative switch, while the alternative allows additional unstated legal criteria beyond the local pair.

changed_reading.before: The exemplar demands blanket social distance from an out-group.
changed_reading.after: The exemplar is calibrated relational judgment: active aggression closes alliance, while its absence leaves room for expansive goodness and equity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two testing lexemes create an assay sequence around the focus. Goodness is not merely attractive appearance: the exemplar is material that must survive the furnace-like trial and the heart-revealing examination, while the closing حميد can be heard as praiseworthiness found through experience.

activation_trace.role: Goodness opposed to ugliness supplies the quality whose depth the surrounding tests probe.
Testing metal and people supplies an assay image for distinguishing apparent from durable goodness.
A trial that reveals what is in the heart supplies a second, interior assay of professed orientation.
Refinement after examination supplies the possibility that testing not only detects but also clarifies the viable pattern.
Finding something praiseworthy after experience supplies the closure: tested goodness culminates in discovered praiseworthiness.

structural_cues: 60:5 places fitna immediately before the focus; 60:10 later commands examination of claimed faith.
The focus itself joins hasana to Hamid, placing a quality term and an evaluative divine name in one ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two distinct test images plus goodness and experiential praiseworthiness; I infer an assay relation among them, while the alternative is that the tests concern separate subjects and do not define the exemplar's goodness.

changed_reading.before: Good exemplar means an obviously attractive precedent.
changed_reading.after: Good exemplar means a pattern whose goodness remains legible under trial, exposes the heart, and is found praiseworthy after use rather than merely on first appearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Migration and changed allegiance rupture households, bonds, and expenditures; the later legal sequence verifies persons, releases bonds that no longer hold, and compensates losses by equivalence. The focus exemplar thus becomes an administrative form of wound repair, not only a dramatic declaration.

activation_trace.role: Repair and solidarity anchor the focus pattern in practical restoration after social rupture.
Departure from one abode to another supplies the concrete displacement that initiates the repair process.
Heart-revealing examination supplies verification before the community reassigns relational and legal standing.
Restoration to a former state supplies the prohibited reversal that would undo the migrant's changed position.
Dissolution of a prohibition supplies the changing legal status of intimate bonds across the rupture.
Money going out in expenditure supplies the measurable loss that repair must account for.
Holding and confining supply the rejected attempt to preserve a bond after its viable conditions have failed.
A protective hold supplies the bond's original function and clarifies why an emptied bond should not be retained as a shell.
Loss beyond reach supplies the unresolved deficit carried forward from a departed spouse.
Substitution and guarantee supply a compensatory mechanism after the original relation cannot be recovered.
Equivalence and likeness supply the measure that keeps compensation proportionate to the expenditure.
Divine lack of need prevents material accounting from being mistaken for payment to God; it serves injured humans.

structural_cues: 60:10 sequences arrival, examination, non-return, changed marital status, reimbursement, and release of bonds.
60:11 continues the accounting when a spouse and expenditure are lost, requiring an equivalent replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies displacement, verification, released bonds, outgoing wealth, loss, substitution, and equivalence; I infer a causal repair workflow for harms produced by changed allegiance, while the alternative reads these as discrete rules without feedback into the focus exemplar.

changed_reading.before: The exemplar is exhausted by courageous speech and separation.
changed_reading.after: The exemplar continues as procedural repair: changed allegiance must be verified, failed bonds released, and material losses equitably closed rather than left behind as collateral damage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exemplary pattern becomes reproducible through a public pledge whose negative boundaries culminate in obedience within recognized good and whose failures remain answerable to forgiveness. Exemplarity moves from remembered precedent into a living social contract.

activation_trace.role: The imitable exemplar anchors the later pledge as a means of reproducing the focus pattern in new agents.
A pledge of obedience supplies the public form by which the pattern is accepted and renewed.
Departure from obedience supplies the breach the covenant names and constrains.
Good recognized by self, reason, and norm supplies the bounded content of obedience rather than unlimited personal command.
Protection from fault's effect supplies a restorative horizon around a serious but non-utopian covenant.
Beneficent, well-performed action links the recognized good of the pledge back to the focus's good exemplar.

structural_cues: 60:12 repeats the pledge verb before and after a concrete list, giving the list a covenantal frame.
The obedience clause is explicitly qualified by recognized good and followed by intercession for forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a framed pledge, specified boundaries, qualified obedience, and forgiveness; I infer that covenant is the transmission mechanism of the exemplar, while the alternative is that the pledge regulates only this cohort without interpreting 60:6.

changed_reading.before: The exemplar remains a past scene available for private admiration.
changed_reading.after: The exemplar can be transmitted as a bounded public covenant: concrete restraints, obedience only in recognized good, and a restorative response to failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context repeats affiliation and the later horizon but replaces hope with severed hope and companionship with graves. Hope in the focus is therefore not private optimism alone; it is an affiliation filter that resists social worlds organized by a closed future.

activation_trace.role: The heart's expectation supplies the open future that qualifies the focus audience.
Withdrawal anchors the consequence of refusing the open, Godward pattern.
Love, support, and alliance supply the social attachment that is now tested by the attached group's horizon.
The cutting off of hope supplies the exact affective inverse of the focus audience's expectation.
The later reality supplies the shared object toward which the focus hopes and the closing group has lost hope.
Companionship and abiding association supply the terminal social image attached to the graves.
Concealment of the dead in graves supplies the closed horizon against which living hope is defined.

structural_cues: 60:13 repeats both tawalli and the later-life term from the focus while setting hope and despair in direct opposition.
The final comparison terminates in companionship with graves, making a closed social horizon the surah's last image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated affiliation language, the same later horizon, hope's exact negation, and grave-companionship; I infer that affiliations can reinforce or erode eschatological openness, while the alternative is that despair only identifies the prohibited group and does not causally affect associates.

changed_reading.before: Hope for God and the later day is an inward credential for benefiting from the example.
changed_reading.after: Hope is also a social discernment practice: the exemplar protects an open future from affiliations whose settled horizon has become despair and burial.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins reproductive and lactational branch images to a political relation; it remains anchored in the focus verb يَرْجُوا۟ and the immediate movement from hostility to affection, but downstream prose must present it as a material analogy for latent possibility, never as the lexical translation of either verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَرْجُوا۟ in 60:6, followed immediately by the possible making of affection in 60:7.

activation_trace.role: A pregnant bearer nearing delivery supplies hope as carrying an unseen outcome close to emergence.
Hope for milk's return supplies a second bodily image of provision reappearing after interruption.
Making something enter a new state supplies the transition from latent possibility to manifest relation.
Affection supplies the social outcome carried toward emergence and return.

changed_reading.before: Hope is passive optimism that an enemy may someday become friendly.
changed_reading.after: Hope can be carried like a near birth or returning nourishment: truthful boundaries coexist with a latent affection whose conditions are not yet visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads dissociation through medical treatment rather than only social conflict; it remains anchored by the focus inventory's wound-treatment branch and the context root's coexisting separation and recovery branches, but downstream prose must qualify debridement as a reader-supplied causal analogy and not equate hostility itself with healing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The wound-treatment field of أُسْوَةٌ in 60:6 and the explicit dissociation in the precedent to which فِيهِمْ points.

activation_trace.role: Treatment of a wound supplies the governing medical analogy for the exemplar.
Dissociation and distance supply the cutting-away movement within the treatment analogy.
Recovery from illness supplies the coexisting restorative destination latent in the same contextual root.
Protective covering from a fault's effect supplies a later healing phase after truthful separation.

changed_reading.before: Dissociation is simply the exemplary end state.
changed_reading.after: Dissociation may be the debridement phase of an exemplar-as-treatment: a clean boundary removes what sustains injury so that protection and repaired relation can later become possible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant م ر ج mapping for the focus root and connects it to later knot and bond imagery; it remains formally anchored through the supplied split inventory and the focus occurrence of يَرْجُوا۟, but downstream prose must call it a form-distant activation and must not translate hope as confusion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's split inventory under ر ج و at يَرْجُوا۟ and the later work of testing, untying, and releasing relational bonds.

activation_trace.role: Mixture and disturbance supply the difficult field inside which hope must maintain orientation.
Interlaced branches and a bent arrow supply a material image for obligations whose paths have become tangled.
Refinement after examination supplies a way to clarify viable commitments within the mixture.
Untying a knot supplies the practical operation for disentangling relations whose legal status has changed.
A fastening by which one holds supplies the bond that must be distinguished from the surrounding entanglement.

changed_reading.before: Hope requires a clear path and uncomplicated loyalties.
changed_reading.after: Hope may be precisely the orientation preserved inside a mixed, tangled field while examination distinguishes which bonds to keep and which knots to release.

strongest_changes: The repeated exemplar is exception-aware and composite rather than wholesale imitation of one declaration.
The boundary is conduct-calibrated and reversible: aggression constrains alliance, while nonaggression permits beneficence and justice and changed conditions permit affection.
Exemplarity expands from dramatic dissociation into vulnerable prayer, legal repair, equitable accounting, and public covenant.
Hope becomes both an eschatological threshold posture and an affiliation filter opposed to a socially reinforced closed future.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made the focus a hinge: exact repetition looked backward to a precedent with an internal exception, while the following verses reopened affection and unfolded the exemplar into testing, bond release, compensation, covenant, and finally the hope-versus-despair contrast. The wound-treatment, assay, gestational, and entanglement branches preserved materially different readings without forcing them into a single interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: How strongly فِيهِمْ selects the whole collective sequence rather than chiefly the dissociation speech remains grammatically live.
The causal claim that affiliation can reinforce despair is abductive; 60:13 may only classify a prohibited alliance.
The gestational, debridement, and non-dominant م ر ج activations are packet-grounded but intentionally form-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The assay model may connect separate legal and devotional tests more tightly than the local syntax alone requires.
